name: php-baremetal/ext-events
description: Event bus: events, listeners, timer, pin and button sources. Core, every firmware requires it.

events-small.description: Small event slots (32 bytes each, allocated at boot): every queued event, dispatch() event, HTTP request and WebSocket frame takes one; 4 more are kept for object releases.

events-medium.description: Medium event slots (256 bytes each, allocated at boot), for events with a payload.

events-large.description: Large event slots (2 KB each, allocated at boot), for events with a large payload.
